'''Azraj-Nug''' was an [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Azraj-Nug was one of the Ongree who worshipped the teachings of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. He was later killed by operatives of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who had been sent to acquire the [[Infinite Engine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
If the player decides to choose the dark side action, Azraj-Nug and the other Ongree slaves are killed, and the Infinite Engine is given to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
